body: Shared theme for all explorer pages. Types come from the foreword UI modules. The dark-gold theme is defined here. Extra DOM stubs beyond WebRuntime are declared below.

author: reek
body: All CSS is generated from this Theme record at runtime via inject-theme-css. No page defines CSS strings.

author: reek
body: Stubs unique to ExplorerTheme that are not in WebRuntime.

author: reek
body: Declarative widget constructors built on widget-custom. Data is encoded in children (one label per option / button) and wn-state (selected index, seed default, primary flag). The HTML plug's _wkCustom renders each tag using the shared component CSS classes (.dim, .hero, .hist, .prow, .tb, .nv). No page emits HTML strings.

author: reek
body: Pip-tree dimension selector: a head pip (current value) that on hover reveals option pips (flat) or category pips that themselves reveal their members (grouped). Leaves carry the global option index in wn-state.

author: reek
body: Colored leaf pip (rarity): name in child 0, hex colour in child 1, global index in wn-state. Category by explicit index list (for the Type tree, whose members are not a contiguous range of item-categories).

author: reek
body: Shared by the DB-backed designer pages. A dimension's rows are fetched once over AJAX (/api/d/<table>), stashed as JSON text under a state key, and parsed on demand into a list of rows (each row a list of text fields). json-parse is the HTML runtime's JSON.parse (its stub body is never emitted). text-to-int is pure Codex so it needs no runtime builtin; it is used to read the integer group bounds (from/to) of grouped dimensions.

author: reek
body: Shared page scaffold and generation body builder for the DB-backed designer apps. Each designer calls designer-page-tree with its nav id, title, and prompt placeholder; the scaffold provides the standard layout (nav, header, prompt field, dimension row placeholder, hero, button bar, history panel, lightbox). gen-body builds the /api/generate JSON payload.
